[MUST] DOTNET-FIELD-INSTANCE-PREFIX: Internal and private instance fields use the _ prefix.
  checks: prefix=_

[MUST] DOTNET-FIELD-NONPUBLIC-CASE: Internal and private fields use camelCase after their applicable field prefix.
  checks: casing=camelCase
